name: sops-decrypt-sub
description: Block sops subcommands that decrypt into plaintext.

rules.name: block-sops-decrypt-subcommand
rules.reason: Decrypting a sops file prints plaintext to the agent.

rules.name: block-sops-exec-env
rules.reason: exec-env decrypts sops secrets into a child process environment.

rules.name: block-sops-exec-file
rules.reason: exec-file decrypts sops secrets into a temporary file.
